commands_run: clan patch-data test-sandbox/happy/heavy/h2-clan-rep3/work/doc.clan test-sandbox/happy/lite/_inputs/h2-supplied/07-competitive-intel.json --agent 07-competitive-intel --action "added 07-competitive-intel findings" --rationale "<handoff text, transcoded WINDOWS-1252 to UTF-8>"

errors.what: clan read/patch failed with 'No such file or directory' on repo-root-relative paths because cwd is the heavy/ subdir, not repo root
errors.recovered_by: resolving repo root via git rev-parse and running clan from the repo root with the repo-relative paths

errors.what: clan patch-data rejected the --rationale arg with 'invalid UTF-8' because handoff.txt is WINDOWS-1252 encoded (stray 0x97 em-dash byte)
errors.recovered_by: transcoding the handoff text with iconv -f WINDOWS-1252 -t UTF-8 before passing it as the rationale

problems_and_friction: The supplied handoff.txt was Windows-1252 encoded (a 0x97 em-dash byte) which broke the patch-data --rationale arg until transcoded to UTF-8 via iconv. The cwd is the heavy/ subdir while protocol paths are repo-root-relative, so clan had to be run from the repo root. The work doc already carried later-hop fields from a prior run, so the comp_* merge-patch was effectively idempotent.
context_understood: I merge-patched the five role-namespaced competitive-intel findings (comp_* HubSpot/Zoho/Salesforce strengths plus Zoho low switching cost and export clause) into the data-only rep3 CLAN doc, recording the handoff note as provenance rationale without re-transcribing prior analysts' data.
